blocks.text: Toxicity (zehreelapan) yeh hai ke koi substance kisi organism (jandaar) ya environment (mahol) ko kis had tak nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Material apni production (banne), use aur aakhri disposal (phenkne) ke waqt toxic ho sakta hai. Toxicity is se napi jati hai ke material kitna aur kis qism ka hazard (khatra) paida kar sakta hai. Hazards kai qism ke hain. Sab se pehle health hazards hain, yani substance ke exposure (saamne aane) se health ko nuqsan. Maslan chromium jaisi metals carcinogens (cancer paida karne wali), mutagens (DNA aur genes badalne wali) hain aur saans ki bimariyan (respiratory issues) deti hain. Aik aur misal plastics ke kuch additives (milaye gaye chemicals) hain jo jism mein hormones ki kharabi kar sakte hain.

Kuch materials apni physical ya chemical properties ki wajah se physical hazards paida karte hain. Yeh nuqsan buildings (imaraton), insanon, ecosystems aur environment ko ho sakta hai. Maslan flammable (aag pakarne wala) ya explosive (dhamaka karne wala) material insanon aur forests (jangalon) ko nuqsan de sakta hai ya building ko tabah kar sakta hai. Environmental hazards woh substances paida karte hain jo aquatic life (pani mein rehne wale jandaar) ya environment ko lambe arse tak nuqsan dete hain. Lead, mercury aur cadmium jaisi heavy metals soil (mitti) aur groundwater (zameen ke neeche ka pani) mein leach ho (reas kar ja) sakti hain. Heavy metals paudon, zameen par rehne wale janwaron, aur machhli aur doosre aquatic jandaron ke liye khatarnak hain.
